crossRefs.note: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.
The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.
Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.

translations.web: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.
translations.bsb: Put an end to the evil of the wicked, but establish the righteous, O righteous God who searches hearts and minds.
translations.kjv: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.
translations.asv: O let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish thou the righteous: For the righteous God trieth the minds and hearts.
